description: Kyle Schultz begins the MLW concept in Brighton, Michigan.
MLW's first season documented; two teams, Western Wildcats and Eastern Eagles.
MLW begins filming seasons, creating an unusually complete video archive.
Cultz Field becomes the home of MLW through 2017.
Central Cardinals become the first non-Wildcat World Series champion.
Tommy Coughlin retires; Wildcats rebuild around a new cast.
Midwest Mallards win the World Series after trailing Coastal Cobras 0-2.
MLW moves to its current home, The Meadows, in Brighton, Michigan.
MLW's Wiffle in the Mitten public tournament debuts.
Eight-team structure becomes established for the modern era.
MLW completes an unconventional 11th season; Great Lakes Gators win their first title.
Downtown Diamondbacks win their first World Series.
World Series is played at SoFi Stadium in Los Angeles.
World Series is played at Mercedes-Benz Stadium in Atlanta.
World Series is played at AT&T Stadium in Arlington, Texas.
World Series is played at George C. Page Stadium at Loyola Marymount University in Los Angeles.
Official site lists eight active teams and a 17th annual All-Star Game/Home Run Derby.
